greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo nenceba kaThixo uBawo naye uYesu Krestu kuni nonke.
penitential:

homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntu ehleli ecaleni kwendlela, emnyameni, engaboni nto, elinde ukukhanya okungafikiyo. KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela ngomntu onjalo—imfama eyayihlala ecaleni kwendlela yaseJeriko, icela inceba. Mamele kakuhle: 'Wayesiva isihlwele sidlula, ebuza ukuba kwenzeka ntoni.' Le ndoda yayingaboni, kodwa yayiva. Yayiva ukuba kukho into eyahlukileyo eyenzekayo. Yayiva ukuba uYesu waseNazarete uyadlula.

Ngamanye amaxesha, ubomi buyafana nendlela yaseJeriko. Sihlala ecaleni, ngamanye amaxesha simnyama, siziva ngathi asiboni ndlela yakuphuma kwiintlungu. UBenjamin Vo wayeyazi imfihlelo yokubona ngezinto ezibalulekileyo. UBen wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, efunda nge-AI kunye ne-cloud infrastructure, kodwa wayengaboni nje ngeekhompyutha. Wayebona ngentliziyo. Wayebona ubuhle kwizinto ezincinci, njengaxa wayethanda ukubukela iinqwelo-moya kunye nobawo wakhe. Wayebona uthando kwiintsapho, wayebona ukubaluleka kokunceda abanye.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle: UThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje.

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uYohane uthi: 'Nokuba unayo le nto: ulahle uthando lwakho lokuqala.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Oku akuthethi ukuba uThixo usigxeka, kodwa usikhumbuza ukuba uthando lokuqala—uthando olusulungekileyo, olungenabugqi—lulapho uThixo efuna ukuba sibe khona. UBen wayenalo olo thando. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukugigitheka xa ethetha ngale 'con chim airlines' yakhe. Yayiyinkampani engazange ibe khona emhlabeni, kodwa entliziyweni kaBen, yayiyinyaniso. Yayiyiphupha elincinci, kodwa elalithwele ithemba elikhulu. Wayengayenzi ngenxa yodumo, wayeyenza ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda indlela izinto ezibhabha ngayo, indlela ezikhululekileyo ngayo. Olo yayiluthando lwakhe lokuqala—ukubona ubuhle, ukunika, nokumomotheka.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

UYesu wabuza imfama: 'Ufuna ndikwenzele ntoni?' Le yimbuzo uYesu ayibuza thina namhlanje. Mhlawumbi impendulo yethu ayikho 'ndifuna ukubona,' kodwa 'ndifuna ukuzola.' 'Ndifuna ukukwazi ukuba uBen ukhuselekile.' Mamele: UBen ukhuselekile. Uphakathi kwebhanqueti yasezulwini, apho akukho zintlungu, akukho zifo, akukho mnyama. Ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umphefumlo kaBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ngokunaphakade ekukhanyeni kukaKrestu.
Sithandazela bonke abasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele, abanike ithemba, kwaye abasondeze entliziyweni yakhe.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Krestu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente elingcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze ngomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ukhona, ndize ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Makusikelele uThixo uSomandla, uYise, noNyana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Hamba ngokuthula, ube nethemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Isityhilelo sikaYesu Krestu, asinikwa nguThixo, ukuba sibonise izicaka zakhe izinto ezimele ukwenzeka kamsinya. Wasazisa ngokuthumela ingelosi yakhe kwisicaka sakhe uYohane, ongqina ngelizwi likaThixo nangobungqina bukaYesu Krestu ngokubalisa oko wakubonayo. Unoyolo lowo ufunda ngokuvakalayo, banoyolo abo baphulaphulayo le myalezo yesiprofeto, bagcine oko kubhaliweyo kuyo, kuba ixesha elimisiweyo likufuphi. UYohane, kwiibandla ezisixhenxe eziseAsiya: makube lubabalo kuni noxolo oluvela kulowo ukhoyo, nowayekho, nowuzayo, nakwimimoya esixhenxe ephambi kwetrone yakhe. Ndiva iNkosi isithi kum: 'Engelosini yebandla laseEfese, bhala oku: Lowo ubambe iinkwenkwezi ezisixhenxe esandleni sakhe sokunene, ohamba phakathi kweziphatho zezibane zegolide ezisixhenxe, uthi: Ndiyayazi imisebenzi yakho, ukusebenza kwakho nokunyamezela kwakho, nokuba awunakubanyamezela abangendawo; uvavanye abo bazibiza ngokuba ngabaPostile kodwa bengengabo, wafumanisa ukuba ngabahanahanisi. Ngaphezu koko, unonyamezelo, uye wabandezeleka ngenxa yegama lam, kwaye awudiniwe. Noko ke, ndinoku ngokuchasene nawe: ulahle uthando lwakho lokuqala. Qonda ukuba uwe kangakanani na. Phenduka, wenze imisebenzi owawuyenza ekuqaleni. Kungenjalo, ndiya kuza kuwe, ndisuse isiphatho sesibane sakho endaweni yaso, ngaphandle kokuba uphenduke.'

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Aboyisayo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi. Unoyolo umntu ongahambiyo ngokucebiswa ngabangendawo, ongayiyo indlela yezoni, ongahlaliyo kunye nabasezihlekisayo. Kodwa uyonwabela umthetho weNKOSI, awucamngce umthetho wayo imini nobusuku. R. Aboyisayo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi. Unjengomthi otyalwe ngasemanzini abalekayo, ovelisa iziqhamo zawo ngexesha lawo, namagqabi awo angabuniyo. Konke akwenzayo kuyaphumelela. R. Aboyisayo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi. Akunjalo kwabangendawo, akunjalo; banjengomququ oqhutywa ngumoya. Kuba iNKOSI iyayijonga indlela yamalungisa, kodwa indlela yabangendawo iyaphela. R. Aboyisayo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Njengoko uYesu wayesondela eJeriko, imfama yayihleli ecaleni kwendlela icela inceba, yathi yakuva isihlwele sidlula, yabuza ukuba kwenzeka ntoni. Bamxelela ukuba, 'UYesu waseNazarete uyadlula.' Yadanduluka yathi, 'Yesu, Nyana kaDavide, yiba nenceba kum!' Abantu ababehamba phambili bayikhalimela, beyixelela ukuba ithule, kodwa yaqhubeka idanduluka kakhulu, 'Nyana kaDavide, yiba nenceba kum!' UYesu wema, wayalela ukuba iziswe kuye; yathi yakusondela, uYesu wayibuza, 'Ufuna ndikwenzele ntoni?' Yaphendula yathi, 'Nkosi, ndicela ndibone.' UYesu wayixelela, 'Bona; ukukholwa kwakho kukuphilisile.' Ngoko nangoko yabona, yamlandela, imzukisa uThixo. Xa abantu bakubonayo oku, bonke badumisa uThixo.

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
